items.title: Prose or Con, can you detect AI writing?
items.raw_excerpt: There was a recent thread about a tool that "proves" a human actually wrote something via an animated edit history ( https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=48699969 ). I commented that I can recognize AI writing regardless of such tools, and received some pushback...so, I wanted to be sure I wasn't lying to myself, and made a little game that shows samples or writing in a variety of styles, and you pick whether it's human or AI. It's harder than I expected, especially with current frontier models, but I think AI prose is still detectable.

excerpt_i18n.en: On June 29, NetEase Youdao officially launched its new flagship learning hardware—the Youdao Dictionary Pen X8 series. Unlike the industry’s past emphasis on “larger screens, larger word banks,” Youdao proposed a new concept: “subscription on demand.” Basic word lookup, textbook synchronization, and full-subject Q&A are free for life; advanced AI capabilities such as real-time note organization, in-depth Q&A, and simultaneous interpretation require an additional paid unlock. The X8 Pro comes with a default two-year membership, the X8 base version is priced at 899 yuan, and the full subscription package costs 1,399 yuan. This could be a key signal that the industry is shifting from “hardware spec wars” to “AI service capability competition.” [Image: Youdao Dictionary Pen X8 series poster] From spec competition to service competition: the value anchor is shifting. In recent years, dictionary pen hardware specifications have continuously evolved: screen, word bank, storage and other basic capabilities have been steadily strengthened, becoming industry standards. But as physical configurations increasingly converge, users’ core needs—lack of after-school tutoring, complex textbook version adaptation, disconnect between practice and evaluation standards—still require smarter solutions. This means the differentiation logic for educational hardware is shifting: the real focus of competition is moving from “whose hardware is stronger” to “whose service understands learning better.” The industry’s conventional “hardware bundled with features” logic means users must pay a one-time fee for the full set of capabilities, regardless of actual usage. For parents, this is a waste of education spending; for manufacturers, it drains innovation momentum—since the hardware is already sold,
excerpt_i18n.es: El 29 de junio, NetEase Youdao lanzó oficialmente su nueva generación de hardware de aprendizaje insignia: la serie Youdao Dictionary Pen X8. A diferencia de la tendencia de la industria del hardware de aprendizaje de años anteriores que enfatizaba "pantalla más grande, diccionario más grande", esta vez Youdao presentó un concepto: "suscripción bajo demanda". Búsqueda básica de palabras, sincronización con libros de texto y resolución de dudas de todas las materias son gratuitas de por vida; funciones avanzadas de IA como organización en tiempo real de apuntes de clase, respuestas profundas a preguntas y traducción simultánea requieren un pago adicional para desbloquearse. El X8 Pro incluye una membresía gratuita de 2 años, el X8 básico cuesta 899 yuanes y el precio total de la suscripción es de 1399 yuanes. Esto podría ser una señal clave de que la industria está pasando de "competencia interna en parámetros de hardware" a "competencia en servicios de IA".

items.title: ICML 2026｜上智院、上交大、复旦联合提出FLAG扩散框架，还原空间转录组的基因-空间双重结构
items.raw_excerpt: 原文作者：公众号“ScienceAi” 原文链接： https://mp.weixin.qq.com/s/lhrWc1-ABA4dZObLAuHMHQ 雷峰网转载 空间转录组学（Spatial Transcriptomics, ST）能在保留细胞空间位置的同时测量基因表达，对解析组织微环境与疾病微生态至关重要，但测序成本高、通量低。相比之下，H&E 染色的全切片图像（WSI）在临床中比较容易获取。因此，「以图测谱」，即直接从常规病理图像预测空间基因表达正成为连接低成本影像与高维分子信息的关键桥梁。 然而，现有方法大多将其简化为对每个基因独立的逐点回归，仅以 PCC、MSE 等逐点指标评估，忽略了两类关键的生物学结构：反映调控程序的「基因 - 基因」关系，以及反映组织构筑的「基因 - 空间」分布关系。而现有模型即便在单基因数值上尚可，所生成的表达图谱却常常「形似而神不似」。 为此，上海科学智能研究院（下称上智院）联合上海交通大学、复旦大学等提出了结构感知的潜扩散框架 FLAG（Foundation model representation with Latent diffusion Alignment via Graph）。该框架将任务从「确定性回归」重新定义为「结构化分布建模」，并首次系统揭示与刻画了高维场景下的「基因维度诅咒」（Gene Dimension Curse）。实验表明，FLAG 在保持 PCC/MSE 高度竞争力的同时，于结构保真度指标上实现显著领先。 该研究成果已被 ICML 2026 接收。上智院生命科学方向研究员斯奇、上海交通大学生物医学工程学院博士生王鹏磊，是共同第一作者。上智院生命科学方向 AI 科学家郭昕，上智院 AI 科学家及生命科学方向负责人、复旦大学人工智能创新与产业研究院研究员程远，是共同通讯作者。上智

excerpt_i18n.zh: 原文作者：公众号“ScienceAi” 原文链接： https://mp.weixin.qq.com/s/lhrWc1-ABA4dZObLAuHMHQ 雷峰网转载 空间转录组学（Spatial Transcriptomics, ST）能在保留细胞空间位置的同时测量基因表达，对解析组织微环境与疾病微生态至关重要，但测序成本高、通量低。相比之下，H&E 染色的全切片图像（WSI）在临床中比较容易获取。因此，「以图测谱」，即直接从常规病理图像预测空间基因表达正成为连接低成本影像与高维分子信息的关键桥梁。 然而，现有方法大多将其简化为对每个基因独立的逐点回归，仅以 PCC、MSE 等逐点指标评估，忽略了两类关键的生物学结构：反映调控程序的「基因 - 基因」关系，以及反映组织构筑的「基因 - 空间」分布关系。而现有模型即便在单基因数值上尚可，所生成的表达图谱却常常「形似而神不似」。 为此，上海科学智能研究院（下称上智院）联合上海交通大学、复旦大学等提出了结构感知的潜扩散框架 FLAG（Foundation model representation with Latent diffusion Alignment via Graph）。该框架将任务从「确定性回归」重新定义为「结构化分布建模」，并首次系统揭示与刻画了高维场景下的「基因维度诅咒」（Gene Dimension Curse）。实验表明，FLAG 在保持 PCC/MSE 高度竞争力的同时，于结构保真度指标上实现显著领先。 该研究成果已被 ICML 2026 接收。上智院生命科学方向研究员斯奇、上海交通大学生物医学工程学院博士生王鹏磊，是共同第一作者。上智院生命科学方向 AI 科学家郭昕，上智院 AI 科学家及生命科学方向负责人、复旦大学人工智能创新与产业研究院研究员程远，是共同通讯作者。上智

Original author: WeChat public account "ScienceAi"  
Original link: https://mp.weixin.qq.com/s/lhrWc1-ABA4dZObLAuHMHQ  
Reposted by Leiphone  

Spatial Transcriptomics (ST) measures gene expression while preserving cell spatial locations, which is crucial for analyzing tissue microenvironments and disease microecology, but sequencing costs are high and throughput is low. In contrast, H&E-stained whole-slide images (WSI) are more readily available in clinical settings. Therefore, "image-to-expression"—predicting spatial gene expression directly from routine pathological images—is becoming a key bridge connecting low-cost imaging with high-dimensional molecular information.  

However, most existing methods simplify this task into independent pointwise regression for each gene, evaluating only by pointwise metrics such as PCC and MSE, ignoring two critical biological structures: gene-gene relationships that reflect regulatory programs, and gene-spatial distribution relationships that reflect tissue architecture. Even when current models achieve reasonable single-gene numeric performance, the generated expression maps often "resemble in form but lack essence."  

To address this, the Shanghai Academy of Artificial Intelligence for Science (SAIS), in collaboration with Shanghai Jiao Tong University and Fudan University, proposed a structure-aware latent diffusion framework called FLAG (Foundation model representation with Latent diffusion).

La transcriptómica espacial (Spatial Transcriptomics, ST) permite medir la expresión génica mientras se conserva la ubicación espacial de las células, siendo crucial para analizar el microambiente tisular y la microecología de enfermedades. Sin embargo, su coste de secuenciación es alto y su rendimiento bajo. En contraste, las imágenes completas de secciones teñidas con H&E (WSI) son relativamente fáciles de obtener en la clínica. Por lo tanto, «predecir el perfil a partir de la imagen», es decir, extraer directamente perfiles de expresión génica a partir de las tinciones H&E de rutina, se ha convertido en una dirección prometedora.

excerpt_i18n.en: Li Yanhong first mentioned the new term "DAA" at an internal Baidu briefing around New Year's this year. During the briefing, the team demonstrated a car company's smart agent deployment, listing common metrics like call counts and token consumption. Li Yanhong instead asked: how many agents are active? This later evolved into DAA (Daily Active Agent), officially proposed at the Create conference. If DAU was the key metric in the mobile internet era, Baidu is using DAA to answer a different question in the agent era: how many agents are truly working continuously, being used, and creating value for enterprises? Over the past two years, the most common growth metrics for large models have been call counts, token consumption, and inference costs. Especially this year, with the rapid adoption of Lobster and Agent Harness, more non-technical users are directly using agents to complete tasks, further amplifying token demand and shifting supply-demand dynamics. Many industry practitioners see the AI sector entering a new cycle of call-volume competition, where price, scale, and market share are the top concerns for cloud vendors. However, Xin Zhou, General Manager of Baidu Intelligent Cloud's AI and Large Model Platform, offers a different perspective: he believes the market overestimates the short-term changes brought by Lobster while underestimating the impact of the harness supporting Lobster on enterprise intelligent application deployment.
excerpt_i18n.es: Li Yanhong mencionó por primera vez la nueva palabra "DAA" a principios de este año, durante una reunión interna en Baidu. En ese momento, el equipo presentó la aplicación de un agente inteligente de una empresa automotriz, enumerando indicadores comunes como el número de llamadas y el consumo de tokens. Sin embargo, Li Yanhong preguntó: ¿cuántos agentes inteligentes están activos? Más tarde, esta pregunta evolucionó hasta convertirse en DAA (Daily Active Agent, agentes inteligentes activos diarios), presentada oficialmente en la conferencia Create. Si en la era de Internet móvil el indicador más importante era el DAU, en la era de los agentes inteligentes, Baidu intenta responder otra pregunta con DAA.

The team from the Department of Automation at Tsinghua University introduced a new online sample filtering framework, UDS, which completely overturns the traditional "full data feeding" mode of supervised fine-tuning (SFT) for large models. This technology does not require traversing the entire training dataset. It leverages the model's forward propagation native logits information to simultaneously evaluate sample value and diversity, automatically filtering out duplicate and low-quality samples. It significantly reduces training computational cost without sacrificing model accuracy. In practice, it can nearly halve computational costs while improving training throughput, providing a lightweight fine-tuning solution for the AI industry, which is currently facing high computational demands and resource constraints. Original Author: WeChat public account "Academic Star Seeker's Daily Sign"  
Original link: https://mp.weixin.qq.com/s/JoWhUDPK4mfIqLNBKP0wyA  
Reprinted by Leiphone  
As we all know, Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) is a key step in enabling multimodal large models to understand human language and align with human intent. But while enjoying the benefits of instruction fine-tuning, have you ever considered:  
What if the fine-tuning data is "poisoned"?  
Recent research shows that LVLMs are highly vulnerable to backdoor attacks during the SFT phase. An attacker only needs to inject a small trigger into the images or instructions of the training set to instantly cause the model to "lose its mind" in specific scenarios and output malicious preset responses. Faced with such hidden dangers in open-ended generation scenarios, traditional defense methods are almost completely ineffective.  
Today, we dissect the new ICML 2026 paper BYORn (Bootstrap Your Own Responses), which cleverly leverages the model's own "intuition" and proposes a defense framework that allows training directly on poisoned datasets without the need for data cleaning, enabling the model to become "immune to all poisons."

excerpt_i18n.en: Standing in the Mahavira Hall of Shanhua Temple in Datong, I opened a video call with Doubao, pointed the camera at the Jin dynasty painted sculptures on the left and right, and asked, “Tell me about these Jin dynasty painted sculptures—which statues are most worth a close look?” Doubao, like a real human guide, first “sees and recognizes” the sculptures, then “understands” the question, then “thinks” about how to answer, and finally speaks the response. If you have asked Doubao a question like this at a scenic spot or exhibition, you would find that Doubao’s explanatory ability is already close to that of an ordinary human guide. Pay close attention, and you will notice that more and more agents like Doubao—able to see, hear, think, and speak—are appearing in different life and work scenarios. For them, audio and video are no longer just content consumed in one direction; they are important capabilities that support input and output in the real world. In the trend of human-agent collaboration, the task of video cloud is no longer just to ensure content delivery, but also to support intent interaction between humans and agents. In the past, audio and video were consumed content, and the main task of video cloud was to serve users with clearer, more stable, lower-latency, and lower-cost audio and video, providing a better viewing and interactive experience. Now, agents have become “super users” of video cloud, relying on it to perceive the world, understand the world, execute tasks, and deliver results. Simply
